summary: Adopt the approved hex/Geist Nex identity: SVG masters, product lockups, one-color mark and icon exports, and switch the Controller and local host web UI, website, installer header and boot splash from the retired raster board. API impact: none; artwork, CSS and static assets only.

guide.reason: Only logo artwork changes; no operator workflow, control, label meaning or step changes. The local host header text shortens from CORE LOCAL HOST to LOCAL HOST beside the Nex Core lockup.

api.reason: Static assets and styling only; no Controller operation, Core command/result, client-facing API or installer question contract changes.

state.reason: Static artwork; neither Core nor the Controller stores anything.

verification.method: Web UI: typecheck, npm test, build, test_build_source, Playwright capture of Controller login (light/dark, mobile), rail and local host UI against a mock API. Website: check/build, website_browser.py (static and nginx/CSP) and website_hardening_browser.py. Installer: installer-logo.py on a staged GTK initrd with the new artwork (fails the old), wizard-review.py in disposable QEMU/KVM at 800x600 passed the logo checks and then failed the unrelated masked-password assertion that fails identically at HEAD; boot splash rendered and inspected, not booted in isolinux/GRUB; no full ISO rebuild.

roadmap.reason: Brand artwork only; no roadmap phase, gate or scope changes.
